title: Doesn’t work
body:
Can’t tell if I’m doing it wrong or something but it doesn’t matter how simple or complex a task I type in, it tells me “something ‘s not right” and tells me to make it more simple.

Frankly there are other apps out there that do the same thing and more, like Goblin Tools, and they work and are free
author: crstokes83
